title: AI infrastructure startup Modal says it plans to start using Nvidia's Vera CPUs for the first time for hosting agents, alongside its current Intel and AMD chips (Stephen Nellis/Reuters)
summary: Stephen Nellis / Reuters: AI infrastructure startup Modal says it plans to start using Nvidia's Vera CPUs for the first time for hosting agents, alongside its current Intel and AMD chips — Nvidia (NVDA.O) has won central processor chip business with another fast-growing AI startup that until now relied entirely …
